top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 99, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Heathland Gravel's belgian heathland gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Heathland Gravel's Belgian heathland, European gravel forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 99 miles.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Heathland Gravel. Train it until it feels boring.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Heathland Gravel's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
When someone attacks on belgian heathland gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 99 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
At Heathland Gravel, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Heathland Gravel, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 99 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
The aerobic base that lets you ride belgian heathland gravel at tempo for 99 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
2-minute all-out efforts on belgian heathland gravel. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Heathland Gravel’s 99 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Heathland Gravel requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on belgian heathland gravel to build confidence. Expect: belgian heathland, european gravel, regional event.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 99 miles of belgian heathland gravel in Belgium.
